<?php
/**
 * Secure API Gateway - Request Authorization Module
 * Handles JWT-like token validation and permission enforcement
 * 
 * Security features:
 * - HMAC-SHA256 token signatures
 * - Constant-time comparison for signatures
 * - Strict permission model with role hierarchy
 * - Rate limiting per client
 */

class AuthorizationGateway {
    private string $signingKey;
    private array $roleHierarchy;
    private array $rateLimits;
    private string $storageDir;

    public function __construct(string $signingKey, string $storageDir) {
        if (strlen($signingKey) < 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Signing key must be at least 32 bytes');
        }
        $this->signingKey = $signingKey;
        $this->storageDir = rtrim($storageDir, '/');
        $this->roleHierarchy = [
            'admin' => 100,
            'manager' => 75,
            'editor' => 50,
            'viewer' => 25,
            'guest' => 0
        ];
        $this->rateLimits = [
            'admin' => 1000,
            'manager' => 500,
            'editor' => 200,
            'viewer' => 100,
            'guest' => 20
        ];
        $this->ensureStorage();
    }

    private function ensureStorage(): void {
        if (!is_dir($this->storageDir)) {
            mkdir($this->storageDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Generate a signed authorization token
     */
    public function generateToken(string $userId, string $role, array $permissions, int $ttlSeconds = 3600): string {
        if (!isset($this->roleHierarchy[$role])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid role: ' . $role);
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/', $userId)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid user ID format');
        }

        $header = ['alg' => 'HS256', 'typ' => 'AGW'];
        $payload = [
            'sub' => $userId,
            'role' => $role,
            'perms' => $permissions,
            'iat' => time(),
            'exp' => time() + $ttlSeconds,
            'jti' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16))
        ];

        $headerEnc = $this->base64UrlEncode(json_encode($header));
        $payloadEnc = $this->base64UrlEncode(json_encode($payload));
        $signature = $this->sign($headerEnc . '.' . $payloadEnc);

        return $headerEnc . '.' . $payloadEnc . '.' . $this->base64UrlEncode($signature);
    }

    /**
     * Validate token and check authorization for a specific action
     */
    public function authorize(string $token, string $requiredPermission, int $requiredLevel = 0): AuthResult {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Malformed token');
        }

        [$headerEnc, $payloadEnc, $signatureEnc] = $parts;

        // Verify signature using constant-time comparison
        $expectedSig = $this->sign($headerEnc . '.' . $payloadEnc);
        $providedSig = $this->base64UrlDecode($signatureEnc);

        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $providedSig)) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Invalid signature');
        }

        // Decode and validate payload
        $payload = json_decode($this->base64UrlDecode($payloadEnc), true);
        if (!is_array($payload)) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Invalid payload');
        }

        // Check expiration
        if (!isset($payload['exp']) || $payload['exp'] < time()) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Token expired');
        }

        // Check issued-at is not in the future (clock skew tolerance: 30s)
        if (!isset($payload['iat']) || $payload['iat'] > time() + 30) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Token issued in the future');
        }

        // Validate role exists
        $role = $payload['role'] ?? '';
        if (!isset($this->roleHierarchy[$role])) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Invalid role in token');
        }

        // Check role level meets requirement
        if ($requiredLevel > 0 && $this->roleHierarchy[$role] < $requiredLevel) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Insufficient role level');
        }

        // Check rate limit
        if (!$this->checkRateLimit($payload['sub'], $role)) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Rate limit exceeded');
        }

        // Check specific permission
        if (!$this->hasPermission($payload, $requiredPermission)) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Permission denied');
        }

        return new AuthResult(true, 'Authorized', $payload);
    }

    /**
     * Check if the token payload grants the required permission.
     * Supports wildcard permissions (e.g., 'admin:*' grants 'admin:read')
     */
    private function hasPermission(array $payload, string $requiredPermission): bool {
        $permissions = $payload['perms'] ?? [];
        
        if (!is_array($permissions)) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($permissions as $granted) {
            // Direct match
            if ($granted == $requiredPermission) {
                return true;
            }
            
            // Wildcard match: 'resource:*' grants 'resource:action'
            if (is_string($granted) && str_ends_with($granted, ':*')) {
                $prefix = substr($granted, 0, -1); // Remove the '*'
                if (str_starts_with($requiredPermission, $prefix)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Simple file-based rate limiting
     */
    private function checkRateLimit(string $userId, string $role): bool {
        $window = 3600; // 1 hour window
        $limit = $this->rateLimits[$role] ?? 20;
        $file = $this->storageDir . '/rate_' . hash('sha256', $userId) . '.json';

        $data = ['count' => 0, 'window_start' => time()];
        if (file_exists($file)) {
            $content = file_get_contents($file);
            $decoded = json_decode($content, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $data = $decoded;
            }
        }

        // Reset window if expired
        if (time() - $data['window_start'] > $window) {
            $data = ['count' => 0, 'window_start' => time()];
        }

        $data['count']++;

        // Atomic write
        $tmpFile = $file . '.tmp.' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
        file_put_contents($tmpFile, json_encode($data), LOCK_EX);
        chmod($tmpFile, 0600);
        rename($tmpFile, $file);

        return $data['count'] <= $limit;
    }

    private function sign(string $data): string {
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $data, $this->signingKey, true);
    }

    private function base64UrlEncode(string $data): string {
        return rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($data), '+/', '-_'), '=');
    }

    private function base64UrlDecode(string $data): string {
        return base64_decode(strtr($data, '-_', '+/'));
    }
}

class AuthResult {
    public bool $authorized;
    public string $message;
    public ?array $payload;

    public function __construct(bool $authorized, string $message, ?array $payload = null) {
        $this->authorized = $authorized;
        $this->message = $message;
        $this->payload = $payload;
    }
}
